question: Which shooter won the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in January 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Manu Bhaker**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Manu Bhaker** is a renowned Indian shooter who gained international recognition for her exceptional performances in various shooting events. • She has represented India in multiple prestigious competitions, including the **ISSF World Cups**, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games. • In **January 2025**, Manu Bhaker was awarded the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**, India's highest sporting honor, for her outstanding contribution to sports. • The award recognized her achievements, including her multiple **gold medals** in international shooting tournaments and her role in elevating India's profile in the sport. • The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is presented annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to honor athletes who have demonstrated exceptional performance at the international level. • Manu Bhaker's selection for the award was based on her consistent performance, dedication, and ability to inspire young athletes in India.
